Codrops downloadable demo code — MIT
https://tympanus.net/codrops/licensing/ (checked 2026-10-18)

Attribution for algorithm ports in this directory:
Dominik Fojcik — Relighting Images; Dreamy Particles
Cullen Webber — Dual-Scene Fluid X-Ray Reveal
deadrabbbbit — Scanning Effect with Depth Maps
Jatin Chopra — Emissive Dissolve Effect

Relighting, Fluid Reveal, Scanning and Dissolve link MIT from their READMEs
(the referenced LICENSE file is absent). Dreamy Particles is supplied as a
Codrops downloadable demo under the site-wide MIT notice. These are recorded
separately in SOURCES.json; a null GitHub license field is not called a LICENSE file.
Only the effect algorithms were adapted. No source photos, masks, models,
HDR environment maps, sounds, videos or fonts from those demos are included.
